items.title: 福特力壓現代，保住美國第三季銷售第三的位置
items.titleEn: Ford fends off Hyundai to retain No. 3 U.S. sales position in third quarter
items.titleZh: 福特力壓現代，保住美國第三季銷售第三的位置
items.summaryEn: Ford on Friday reported a year-over-year sales decline of 6.6% during the third quarter to 507,395 light-duty vehicles.
items.summaryZh: 福特汽車週五公佈，第三季輕型車銷量年減 6.6%，至 507,395 輛。

items.title: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.titleEn: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
items.titleZh: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.summaryEn: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.
items.summaryZh: 美國勞工統計局表示，9月非農就業人數僅增加2.9萬人，遠低於先前預測的8.4萬人，失業率升至4.2%。

items.title: 隨著全球公債市場暴跌加劇，10年期美國公債殖利率觸及2002年以來最高水準。
items.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
items.titleZh: 隨著全球公債市場暴跌加劇，10年期美國公債殖利率觸及2002年以來最高水準。
items.summaryEn: Treasury yields were higher on Thursday amid a global sell-off in government debt.
items.summaryZh: 週四，受全球公債拋售潮的影響，美國公債殖利率走高。

items.title: 聯準會首選的通膨指標顯示，8月核心通膨率為3.0%，遠低於預期。
items.titleEn: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
items.titleZh: 聯準會首選的通膨指標顯示，8月核心通膨率為3.0%，遠低於預期。
items.summaryEn: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to show an annual gain of 3.7% on headline and 3.3% for core, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
items.summaryZh: 根據道瓊共識預測，個人消費支出物價指數整體年增率預估為 3.7%，核心年增率預估為 3.3%。

items.title: OpenAI DevDay 即時更新：Altman 面臨安全質疑，公司發布新功能

items.summaryEn: Follow CNBC’s live coverage of OpenAI DevDay 2026, including Sam Altman’s 12 p.m. ET interview, keynote and developer announcements.

items.summaryEn: Nvidia said the buyback boost marks the largest share repurchase authorization increase in history.
items.summaryZh: 英偉達表示，此次股票回購授權增幅創歷史新高。
